metadata.axes: X left/right, Y front/back, Z up; carrier nominal top Z8
metadata.color_source: Semantic illustration palette, not exact original STEP face colors.
metadata.section: Display-only capped Boolean cuts of the housing; lid opens the roof to reveal speaker, components and coax. Speaker inspection uses full transparent housing.
metadata.component_geometry: All assigned component and carrier shapes from corrected KiCad STEP; no component proxy blocks.
limitations: Small triangles collapsed by 0.001 mm display rounding are omitted; original CAD is unchanged.
Display tessellation is for inspection, not metrology or manufacturing.
Exploded gaps are presentation offsets, not assembly clearances.
SMA hardware is a fit reference based on analogue dimensions; actual connector dimensions remain unverified.
metadata.sma_hardware: Provisional native R5 connector and 50x8 mm antenna envelopes. Washer/nut/coupler inner voids derived for display, no dimensional claim about the owned kit.
metadata.coax_geometry: Provisional 1.32 mm diameter swept service route to the actual top LoRa IPEX location. 4.8 mm centerline bends, 4.14 mm inner radius; actual cable dimensions and usable length unverified. Coax and plug translate rigidly with base in exploded view, disconnected from board.
metadata.retained_R4_geometry: Unchanged electronics and other part mesh arrays retained exactly after source hash and native retained-part Boolean checks.
metadata.source_status: saved R6 native printed geometry plus audited fit references
metadata.speaker: One speaker fit reference, retained by the lid and removable back retainer. Direct reference leads run to MAX98357A speaker outputs; no PCB attachment.
reference_limitations: Illustrative oval speaker from the photo within the conservative 15 x 10 x 3.5 mm rectangular fit envelope. All engineering collision checks use the full box, not this visual approximation.
Gasket and rear pad rectangles indicate allowance only; trim support to the actual speaker frame and keep the diaphragm clear.
Screw/washer/nut and wire envelopes are references. Actual terminal left/right polarity and wire entry shape require checking on hardware.
metadata.unchanged_geometry: R5 actual electronics, retained printed parts, battery/SMA and coax meshes retain exact arrays; source hashes and R6 native comparisons are recorded separately.
